message.content:
Applied source edits in nine files; no tests, Cargo, formatting, deployment or live operations run.

### Changes
- `op-plugins/state_plugins/large_language_model{,_methods}.rs`: removed seven declarations, facade-only DTOs, planning/completion arms, forwarding helper and obsolete unit assertions. Existing schema test now asserts one method/one capability.
- `op-grpc-bridge/src/large_language_model_dispatch.rs`: removed seven-method unit assertion only. **Production dispatch and shared `observed_tched_router_state` unchanged.**
- Existing facade admission integration tests now exercise `stream_generate` → `start_generation`; owned-task nesting test uses these retained names.
- Antigravity/Antigravity Chat schema defaults/descriptions and bridge observations now identify `tched_router` as catalog owner.
- `gemma_brain.rs`: removed `route` declaration, obsolete route capability-description entry and LLM dependency; retained local methods depend on `json_render`. Updated misleading inference-owner documentation.
- Backing-test migration was handed to **RetireAccessors**, per exclusive ownership; I did not edit that file.

### Removed adapter contracts
These are existing delegation destinations, **not universal lossless caller renames**. Every old outer grant equaled the target grant below, derived from router schema.

| Removed method → destination | Accepted old input → old domain output | Exact old/target grant |
|---|---|---|
| `list_providers` → `ListProviders` | `{}` → `{providers}` | `cap.software.3tched-router.providers.read@v1` |
| `get_provider` → `GetState` | `{}` → `{selected_provider,provider}` projected from `state`, rejecting absent/duplicate selected provider | `cap.software.3tched-router.state.read@v1` |
| `get_config` → `GetState` | `{}` → `{config:{selected_provider,selected_model}}` projected from `state` | `cap.software.3tched-router.state.read@v1` |
| `set_provider` → `SetProvider` | `{provider_id}` → `{selected_provider}` | `cap.software.3tched-router.provider.set@v1` |
| `generate` → `Chat` | `message/messages/provider/model` → `{content,provider,model,finish_reason,usage}` | `cap.software.3tched-router.chat@v1` |
| `list_models` → `ListModels` | optional `provider` → `{model_routes}` | `cap.software.3tched-router.models.read@v1` |
| `update_config` → `SetSelection` | `{provider_id,model_id}` → `{selected_provider,selected_model}` | `cap.software.tched-router.selection.set@v1` |

Old adapters rejected extra keys, decoded/re-encoded typed inputs/results, and unwrapped the canonical envelope’s `result`. Notably, old `generate` rejected `conversation_id`, although canonical `ChatInput` includes it.

### Preserved boundaries / residual evidence
- `stream_generate` registration, `llm.invoke`, nested `cap.software.tched-router.generation.start@v1`, generation-origin pins, owned-task lifetime, private partitions and recovery remain unchanged.
- Gemma route’s retired outer grant was `gemma.invoke`; canonical `ResolveRoute` retains `cap.software.3tched-router.route.resolve@v1`. No grant remapping.
- Literal searches found no retired LLM method/subid references in inspected deploy/scripts or UI source. No demonstrated production invocation is **not** proof of no external consumers.
- UI plugin inventory remains valid because `large_language_model` still exists.
- `ctl_plane_chatbot.chat_llm_plugin` remains explicitly inert legacy metadata.
- Generated catalog/FUSE consumers require parent-owned regeneration/reseal; nothing generated was hand-edited.
- Parent owns final HANDOFF/report integration, including my Active work row and eventual verification.
